questions.question: What is the subject of Psalm 119, the longest chapter in the Bible?
How does the psalmist say a young man can keep his way pure?
options: By heeding the counsel of his elders
By keeping company with the wise
By the strength of his own strong right hand
By guarding it according to God's word
questions.answer: By guarding it according to God's word

questions.question: Psalm 119 says, 'Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.'
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a _____ to my path.
I have stored up your word in my _____, that I might not sin against you.
